steps.name: Inspect Solidity lexical binding metadata
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent sol-bindings {root_dir}/scenarios/sol_bindings/demo_bindings.sol > {output_dir}/binding_report.json && {mumei_agent_python} -c "import json,pathlib; report=json.load(open('{output_dir}/binding_report.json')); source=pathlib.Path('{root_dir}/scenarios/sol_bindings/demo_bindings.sol').read_text(); declaration=next(item for item in report['bindings'] if item['name']=='answer'); assert report['profile']=='mumei.sol-lexical-bindings/v1', report; assert source[declaration['span']['start']:declaration['span']['end']]=='answer', report; assert any(item['binding_id']==declaration['id'] and source[item['span']['start']:item['span']['end']]=='answer' for item in report['references']), report; assert any(item['name']=='missingName' for item in report['unresolved']), report; assert not any(item['name']=='missingName' for item in report['bindings']), report; print('profile=mumei.sol-lexical-bindings/v1; answer resolved; missingName unresolved')"
steps.artifact_contract: binding_report.json contains the observed Solidity route profile, an answer reference linked to the in-file declaration, and unresolved missingName.
steps.verifier_gate: Assertions require the exact versioned profile, matching declaration/reference binding IDs and spans, and missingName only in unresolved.
